Analytic Fortran phase-space repair
  One-process shared-host study; patch remains unapplied. Original 0fcd2cd873d6 control versus a same-flag Fortran candidate.
  Hua-Sheng’s precise local performance acceptance remains pending.


The 2→1 process 𝑢𝑢 → 𝑍 with QCD corrections uses loop_sm and explicitly selected TIRust backend 9. The ordinary
sample contains 100 saved longitudinal boosts and retains independent MadLoop stability checks. Its measured tensor
topology has three propagators and rank two. Only the Fortran repair unit is replaced; all compiler flags and other
numerical objects remain unchanged.

Numerical scope and limits
Two standalone mains complete 544 outer DP/QP repair-wrapper invocations across 136 fixtures per precision and arm.
DP outputs match bit for bit; 94 QP fixture results differ in 233 component words while satisfying the frozen physical-
residual limits. Refused-input outputs, diagnostics and observed IEEE states preserve the original behavior. These tests
do not instrument actual fast-branch coverage.
Fresh learning and final 100-point amplitude runs retain exact coefficient, accuracy and public-status words on all 100
physical points. Each arm returns 200 rows (overall plus the sole split order), containing 800 coefficient and 200 accuracy
fields. The 14 timing batches retain only their final 100-point numerical outputs; their status histograms cover every
timed call. The physical model’s MP mass remains its existing binary64-to-binary128 lift.
This is a descriptive comparison against the current control, separate from the starting-revision default-chain and eight-
process acceptance campaign. Broader process/model qualification and an independent finite-answer oracle remain
open. Recorded IEEE states establish observational parity, without a trap-freedom claim. The source patch remains
unapplied; these results do not promote a backend or establish formal local runtime acceptance.
